name: claude-mem
param_style: ? positional (bun:sqlite prepare/all/get/run); WHERE clauses, IN lists and UNION arms assembled at runtime
schema_source: reconstructed final state of the in-code migration chain in src/services/sqlite/SessionStore.ts, plus FTS5 tables/triggers from SessionSearch.ts and tool_uses from tool-uses.ts (tables the queries use)
data_scale: scale 1: 2k sessions over 20 projects (skewed, 3 worktree projects merged into a parent), 40k observations, 4k summaries, 10k prompts, 20k tool uses, ~100k observation_files rows, FTS5 indexes over observations and summaries
visibility_note: ~104k stars; runs locally for every Claude Code user who installs the plugin; SQLite (bun:sqlite) is the only local store
interest_note: FTS5 MATCH + bm25 rank joined to content tables with stacked filters (correlated platform subquery, json_each concept EXISTS), LIKE/ESCAPE substring fallbacks, SessionStart's UNION-of-per-key-top-N context query, a whole-merge detection UNION with correlated COUNT subqueries, row-value timeline probes, and an ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE upsert with CASE/COALESCE(excluded) rules.
reach_note: new developer plugin; stars likely overstate installed base
